purpose: Close the current high-intensity Book-enrichment discovery pass without claiming that no future source can appear. The remaining gaps are now acquisition/rights/data-linkage problems rather than broad literature-discovery problems. Reopen only when new public raw data, owner authorization, author-supplied records or materially stronger trace-level evidence changes a gap state.

whatIsNowCovered: multiple black-speck/black-dot mechanism and intervention cases
analytical identification ladder for inclusion versus degradation hypotheses
stillRequired: black-speck or contamination observation tied to each shot or sampling interval
post-intervention recovery sequence long enough to verify stabilization
usable rights and sufficient machine/material context
bestAcquisitionTargets: owners/authors of the Wave 7 black-spot and black-dot production studies for underlying control-chart or defect-log records
production partners willing to export reject-camera or quality-log events together with purge/cleaning/maintenance timestamps
the embargoed Leon process/defect campaign after 2027-12-31 only if its released fields actually support the required chronology
gapStates.doNotReopenFor: another generic troubleshooting list, isolated before/after percentage, unlinked defect image set or simulation-only degradation study

whatIsNowCovered: measured valve-gated pressure and branch-flow chronology
servo valve-pin stroke used to alter cavity-pressure transfer
supplier/trade evidence that actual pin position and motor current/force can be monitored
peer-reviewed direct links from distributed melt-valve/pressure control to dimensions, Cp and part-weight consistency
commercial controller documentation showing valve-pin position, mould pressure/temperature and complete-cycle recording can coexist
stillRequired: commanded valve state or target position
motor current, torque or force where available
shared cycle identity/timestamps and reusable rights
bestAcquisitionTargets: IKV/KaskaRe researchers for reusable experimental traces from the servo-electric valve-pin pressure-control programme
EWIKON demonstration-cell owners or customers able to export pin-position/current plus cavity-pressure data
RUNIPSYS/Symbioz 4.0 deployments because public technical documentation states that valve-pin position, mould pressure/temperature and complete cycle information are recorded
authors/institutional archives from the Kazmer dynamic-melt-control programme if historical raw records and semantics survive
gapStates.doNotReopenFor: another valve-gate patent, controller brochure, simulation-only pin-motion study or aggregate quality paper without synchronized actuator-state traces

whatIsNowCovered: roughly thirteen years of real industrial mould-maintenance event history at substantial scale
shot counts at maintenance events for thousands of injection moulds
natural lifecycle/metrology classification across 13 production moulds
production cooling maintenance before/after recovery cases
real mould-maintenance project histories with age, usage, failure/issues and maintenance duration
stillRequired: physical component-condition or measured wear state before intervention
post-maintenance part-quality or metrology recovery linked to the same asset/event
enough repeated history to distinguish one-off repair anecdotes from recurrent degradation/recovery
bestAcquisitionTargets: industrial owner of the 2011-2024 ESREL maintenance history
OLI predictive-maintenance project owners where event-level maintenance/action outcomes may exist
production moulders with structured CMMS plus quality/metrology systems that can be joined under an approved data-use agreement
gapStates.doNotReopenFor: another predictive-maintenance model without intervention/recovery data, simulated wear study or maintenance schedule recommendation without asset-linked measurements

reopenTriggers: a genuinely new public raw injection-moulding dataset appears with one of the required linkage patterns
an author, institution, vendor or industrial owner supplies the underlying records with explicit reusable terms
a currently embargoed dataset becomes legally accessible and its released schema matches a remaining gap
a rights-unresolved mirror gains authoritative provenance and explicit reuse permission
a modern production case publishes synchronized actuator-state, cavity-state and cavity-specific quality traces
editorialDecision: Proceed with Book-owned diagrams, case tables, diagnostic exercises and acquisition requests from Waves 1-9. Do not continue broad discovery merely to increase candidate count; prioritize rights-clear trace acquisition and source-owner outreach for the three open linkage gaps.
